history.content: I'm trying to hire Alex Chen for the backend role.

Nice, congrats on getting to that stage. What do you need from me on this, drafting the offer email, reaching out to schedule a call, or something else? And is Alex Chen someone you've already interviewed, or are they coming in cold?

He did. Alex Chen's reply came in with the subject "Backend role, excited": thanks for the chat, very interested in the backend role, and happy to do a panel next week. Sarah also weighed in separately, Thursday 3pm works best for her if you want her on the panel. Want me to draft the note to Alex proposing that slot? I have not checked a fresh web check this turn, so I can't confirm anything that depends on it.
Schedule him next week for a panel.

Thursday works, with one wrinkle: Sarah wants 3pm, but your only open Thursday slot is 11 AM, 12 PM on Oct 1. I can't see Sarah's calendar, so I don't know if 11 works for her. Want me to propose Thu Oct 1, 11 AM ET to Alex and check with Sarah, or skip Sarah and just book Alex for that slot?
Actually use the time Sarah suggested instead.

Draft's ready for your review, it proposes Thursday, Oct 1 at 3:00 PM ET to Alex, per Sarah's preference. The email is drafted for your review — nothing has been sent yet. One heads up: 3pm Thursday wasn't showing as free on your calendar earlier, so once Alex confirms I'd suggest we put the hold on and sort any conflict then. Want me to draft a quick note to Sarah too so she can lock the slot from her side?
